work_unit.title: Add bilingual README navigation
work_unit.goal: Let Chinese- and English-speaking visitors reach the appropriate project documentation.

evidence.claim: Chinese and English README files were added and linked from the project entry page.
The change is available in the default branch.

value_assessment.summary: A small, complete change removes a real documentation barrier at low human effort; monetary ROI cannot be calculated from the available data.

assumptions: The documentation change is maintained as part of the project.
meta.next_measurement: Track visits or contributor feedback from each language entry point.
